proposals.scope: Per init Store + exact CallContext certificate; never whole-site private_init
premises: Unique current direct LibcMalloc allocation call/context; owner executes at most once, no generation reuse/free/realloc
Exact formal binding, no redefinition, same basic block and no backedge for allocator/init call/first publication
Pure initializer: bounded constant-offset whole scalar/NULL writes, no pointer loads/unknown calls/return pointer
All aliases and representation uses before first publication are closed; no address escape or byte/integer fabrication
Full-width first pointer publication holds verified physical exclusive L and is followed by ordinary unlock L
Reader address is traced to a pointer Load of that same exact published slot; both source load and access hold L
Slot has complete legitimate pointer initial value before relevant creates; all subsequent pointer/byte/unknown effects covered and lifetime valid
Final effect completeness checked after fixpoint; structural cache cannot certify early absence of later effects
proposals.fallback: Retain pair/UNKNOWN whenever any premise is unproved; keep disabled legacy private_init
validation: init then publish under L / early publication before init / no-L publication / different reader source or lock
same helper repeated late initialization / pointer byte corruption / unknown writer / wrong allocation generation
renaming, helper/call context, ILP32/LP64, full AI+BMC pairing and selected AR checks

proposals.scope: Initially homogeneous global pointer arrays written only in main prefix, readonly after possible spawn; not general concurrent mutable arrays
premises: Complete non-TLS defined global array and typed NULL initializer; unique main root, no ctor/custom root
Closed all array address uses and all writes; any create cannot return through CFG to any main array writer
Optional defined inbounds cell certificate ties actual LLVM full Load/Store to exact GlobalVariable allocation and matching AR/layout
GEP array type matches actual complete global object type; reject larger object/alias disguised as subarray, freeze/phi/select/extra transport
S starts at typed NULL; every supported Store immediately monotone joins full pointer value including repeated static-site growth and dirty
Unknown, byte, partial, RMW, opaque effects/creations and late writes permanently invalidate coordinate with dirty
Load snapshots usable S, retains native/interference read, then intersects result; no rewriting prior access records
Keep existing persistent warnings and final change-to-UNKNOWN; no claim of closed general shared writable arrays
proposals.fallback: If actual LLVM defined-prefix access contract cannot be established, use proved native bounds/guard relation or retain UNKNOWN
validation: partial/byte/unknown writes, escaped array address and worker writer; repeated prefix loop values and delayed summary growth
one-past dereference, larger-object subarray disguise, freeze/phi/index transport; exact LLVM+AR origin and both ABIs
separate post-array heap source and init-publication checks; array coordinate alone may not recover whole task

proposals.scope: Later node; universal dynamic instance completion, not one joined static site
premises: Every array slot and dynamic create/join instance has matching identity and completion proof
proposals.fallback: Retain empty MUST joined digest/candidates when universal completion is not proved
